summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript-react preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (declared in package.json as `preinstall: node setup.mjs`) auto-executes on npm install. setup.mjs is itself identifier-mangled/obfuscated and constructs a download URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, fetches and extracts the Bun runtime binary, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB Bun-compiled CommonJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) heavily obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers, a shuffled string-array rotator, and a character-decoder dispatch — no source-form logic is visible. The package's advertised purpose is an ESLint configuration, which has no legitimate need to download a second language runtime at install time or to execute a bundled obfuscated payload under it. Deliberately loading the payload under an alternate runtime bypasses Node-based module inspection, and the cover-story filenames (`setup.mjs`, `math_init.js`) do not reflect the actual behavior. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape, executed automatically at install time on any machine that installs this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
